summary: Multi-city (3+ leg) searchCriteria is CONFIRMED NOT SUPPORTED (or at minimum hard-capped at 2 entries) for GulfAir/KSA on this host — resolves Round 3's INCONCLUSIVE finding. A 9-combination sweep (7 distinct 3-leg/4-leg routings across every route pair with previously-confirmed live one-way inventory, plus 2 boundary-isolation probes) returned HTTP 200 with an empty offers[] in all 9 cases, INCLUDING a control using the exact same BAH-RUH/RUH-BAH pair three times in a row — a pair independently proven to return 125-175 offers when submitted as a 2-entry array. The cutoff is precisely at 2 vs. 3+ searchCriteria entries, not at route/inventory validity.

A 2-entry searchCriteria array is CONFIRMED supported for GulfAir/KSA in BOTH shapes: a mirrored round-trip (BAH-RUH outbound / RUH-BAH return, 175 offers) and a non-mirrored open-jaw (BAH-RUH outbound / JED-BAH return — different destination and origin pair, 125 offers). A 2-entry array where the second leg continues from the first leg's destination to a third, non-hub city (BAH-RUH then RUH-JED) returns 0 offers, consistent with GulfAir having no live RUH-JED inventory (a genuine route gap, not a searchCriteria-length limitation).

Re-confirmed: Book trusts cellCode, not cellId, when the two refer to different cells — the API attaches and prices whichever cellCode was submitted (this round: 8C at 120.00 SAR) regardless of what the accompanying cellId token actually decodes to (8B). Unchanged from Rounds 1-3.

A 2-entry array is supported in both round-trip (mirrored) and open-jaw (non-mirrored) shapes.
